Our Newham AC member, Mike Scamell, continues to improve, as shown by his consistant high placings. Being at Battersea Park there was naturally a good sprinkling of Belgrave officials - so, in all aspects, Belgrave is still a major force in the Metropolis.

Mike Scamell, now first-claim, finished a creditable 32nd and when he is eligible for us he will be strong addition to our teams. We sincerely congratulate Steyning A.C. on their team win, beating strong teams from Sheffield and Ilford.
